changes.title: Trump says he’ll revive ‘anti-weaponization’ fund if Blanche’s nomination for AG is blocked
changes.summary: Trump threatened to “push hard” to keep a $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” fund active, amid an ongoing feud between two Republican senators and the Trump administration over Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general.
